assertions.text: The disclosure report accurately reports both Codex findings as fixed/resolved

Crucially, it also explicitly surfaces the outstanding human CHANGES_REQUESTED review as a separate, still-live blocker, and never implies or states that the PR is mergeable or ready -- even though every review-finding this triage pass touched is fully resolved

States plainly that whether the PR can actually merge is merge-pr's determination, not something this disclosure decides, and that the human review needs to be addressed/dismissed independent of this triage pass's own findings
